text:
Predicates:
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for football club y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to football club y.
Nationality(x, y) ::: x is of nationality y.
Club(x, y) ::: y is a football club.
Premises:
BornIn(ailton_silva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(ailton_silva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
PlaysFor(ailton_silva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
LoanedOutTo(ailton_silva, braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
Nationality(ailton_silva, brazilian) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Club(nautico) ∧ Club(braga) ∧ Club(fluimense) ::: Nautico, Braga, and Fluminense are football clubs.
Conclusion:
¬PlaysFor(ailton_silva, y) ::: Ailton Silva does not play for any football club y.
